decision: Petition for a WATER charter carrying a surplus-capital clause instead of petitioning for a bank charter
state_before: Two banks only in the City and State and charters unobtainable from the party in control
information_available: The 1798 yellow-fever epidemic attributed to an inadequate water supply; an opposition leader in the Legislature; the phrase 'any other monied transactions or operations'
unknowns: Whether the water purpose was ever intended to be operated or only to pass
alternatives: Petition for a bank charter directly; wait for a change of legislative control; take no bank at all
constraints: A hostile legislative majority; a clause that could be attacked; 'a great effort was made to defeat the charter'
rationale: A public purpose the majority could not refuse with banking capacity attached to it
actual_result: A bill passed 1799-04-02 and received the Governor's signature; the bank opened 1799-09-01

decision: Direct the new company's first effort to water and not to money
alternatives: Open the banking office immediately; divide the two purposes equally
rationale: 'The principal object of this incorporation being to obtain a supply of pure and wholesome water for the City of New York'
expected_result: A three-man committee appointed to report the best means of obtaining supply

decision: Accept the committee report and open an office of discount and deposit
state_before: Capital fully subscribed 1799-05-15; water works not yet operating
information_available: The charter's surplus-capital clause; idle subscribed capital
unknowns: Whether the move was planned in April or forced by the water delay
alternatives: Leave capital idle; lend only against the water works
constraints: The clause's own limit (not inconsistent with the constitution and laws of New York or the United States)
actual_result: The 'Bank' began business 1799-09-01 in a bought house

decision: Fix the operating interface: posted counter hours advertised in a daily paper; a board sitting Mondays and Thursdays; a vault-examining committee within two months
information_available: Customary exchange hours; the directors' own minute practice
alternatives: Trade quietly without advertising; meet monthly
constraints: No external rule required either; the practice was voluntary

actual_result: Semi-weekly meetings said to still prevail in the carrier's undated present

state_before: Post-epidemic move to Greenwich; growth constraints
actual_result: REJECTED OPTION ON RECORD: 'it failed to pass and the plan was abandoned'

decision: Accept the Legislature's reserved right to 1000 shares and raise capital to 2050000

actual_result: Incorporated at Albany for twenty-one years; banking charter obtained within fourteen months
